name: Manami Seira
source:
A high school girl, she's [url=http://vndb.org/c11694]Kentarou's[/url] girlfriend. Though she is in love with Kentarou she's afraid of losing her virginity to him and seeks advice from [url=http://vndb.org/c11693]Yuusaku[/url].

She enjoys window shopping and cafes.
